title: Pokemon - Wimpod - 048/182 - Reverse Holo - Paradox Rift  - NM/M
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Wimpod card from the Pokémon Trading Card Game features a Reverse Holo design and is a must-have for any collector. The card is from the Paradox Rift series and is numbered 048/182. It is a Pokémon type card and is manufactured by Pokemon. 

The Wimpod card is in great shape and is a NM/M rarity. It is a perfect addition to any CCG individual card collection or any collectible card game set. Don't miss your chance to own this highly sought-after card.
